name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 8 - Am 115
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 8. Rejects the proposed full mobilisation of the Ukraine Support Loan Instrument for EUR 1 115 000 000; reiterates its opposition to the EUR 90 billion Ukraine Support Loan, to common Union borrowing and to the use of the headroom of the Union budget as a guarantee; notes, nevertheless, that legally binding debt-service obligations already entered into must be honoured; insists that any appropriations entered in the 2027 budget be limited to amounts that are legally unavoidable, actually fall due in 2027 and are supported by a detailed and independently verifiable cash-flow forecast; calls for full reporting on borrowing, disbursements, final recipients, procurement, interest and liquidity-management costs, contingent liabilities and compliance with anti-corruption conditions; opposes any further common borrowing or increase in the guarantee provided by the Union budget;
